datasheet_identity.title: DSL34 THRU DSL310 SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage VRRM is 40 V and maximum average forward rectified current IF(AV) is 3.0 A at Ta = 25 degC (p. 1).
Non-repetitive peak forward surge current IFSM is 60 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave (p. 1).
No junction-capacitance value or reverse-recovery time is published.
The forward curve is a family characteristic for DSL34, DSL36, and DSL310; the DSL34 trace is the solid curve.
No breakdown characteristic is published for DSL34.
